notes: Next.js 14 -> 15 major upgrade on a BigCommerce-owned repo. The repo uses npm: it has package-lock.json and no yarn.lock at base, so the checks are npm ('npm ci', 'npm test', 'npm run type-check', 'npm run lint'). Scripts at base: 'test': 'jest', 'type-check': 'tsc --pretty --noEmit', 'lint': 'next lint'. The diff touches package.json (next ^14.2.35 -> ^15.5.21) and the lockfile; 4 files changed but ~4.8k/2.6k lines are almost all package-lock.json churn, so most of the line count is not migration code. The real migration surface is small (dependency bump + any code the Next 15 async-request-API / caching defaults required). base_commit is the first parent of the merge commit. Caveat for L1: 'prebuild' runs 'prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy', so a full build needs a database; 'npm test' (jest) should run without one. Verify before enabling L1 for this case.
